sentences.en: A Operating on the same principle as wind turbines, the power in sea turbines comes from tidal currents which turn blades similar to ships’ propellers, but, unlike wind, the tides are predictable and the power input is constant.
sentences.zh: 与风力涡轮机一样,海洋涡轮机的动力来自潮汐流,潮汐流使叶片与船舶的螺旋桨相似,但与风不同,潮汐是可预测的,电源输入是恒定的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The technology raises the prospect of Britain becoming self-sufficient in renewable energy and drastically reducing its carbon dioxide emissions.
sentences.zh: 这一技术提高了英国在可再生能源方面实现自给自足的前景,并大幅度降低了二氧化碳排放量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: If tide, wind and wave power are all developed, Britain would be able to close gas, coal and nuclear power plants and export renewable power to other parts of Europe.
sentences.zh: 如果潮汐、风和波浪的电力都得到发展,英国将能够关闭天然气、煤炭和核电厂,并将可再生能源出口到欧洲其他地区。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Unlike wind power, which Britain originally developed and then abandoned for 20 years allowing the Dutch to make it a major industry, undersea turbines could become a big export earner to island nations such as Japan and New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 英国最初开发了风力,后来又放弃了20年,让荷兰人将风力作为主要工业,而海底涡轮机则不同,它可能成为日本和新西兰等岛屿国家的一个大出口赚取者。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B Tidal sites have already been identified that will produce one sixth or more of the UK’s power – and at prices competitive with modern gas turbines and undercutting those of the already ailing nuclear industry.
sentences.zh: 已经确定了将生产英国六分之一或六分之一以上电力的潮汐点 — — 价格与现代燃气涡轮机竞争,并削弱已经陷入困境的核工业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: One site alone, the Pentland Firth, between Orkney and mainland Scotland, could produce 10% of the country’s electricity with banks of turbines under the sea, and another at Alderney in the Channel Islands three times the 1,200 megawatts of Britain’s largest and newest nuclear plant, Sizewell B, in Suffolk.
sentences.zh: 仅一个网站,即奥克尼与苏格兰大陆之间的彭特兰法尔斯(Pentland Firth),就能用海底涡轮机发电10%,而海峡群岛奥尔德尼的另外一个网站,是英国最大的、最新的核电厂苏福克的1 200兆瓦,即Ssimpwell B。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Other sites identified include the Bristol Channel and the west coast of Scotland, particularly the channel between Campbeltown and Northern Ireland.
sentences.zh: 查明的其他地点包括布里斯托尔海峡和苏格兰西海岸,特别是坎贝尔镇与北爱尔兰之间的通道。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C Work on designs for the new turbine blades and sites are well advanced at the University of Southampton’s sustainable energy research group.
sentences.zh: C 南安普敦大学可持续能源研究小组已充分推进新涡轮叶片和场址的设计工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The first station is expected to be installed off Lynmouth in Devon shortly to test the technology in a venture jointly funded by the department of Trade and Industry and the European Union.
sentences.zh: 第一个站预计不久将在德文林茅斯附近安装,以测试贸易和工业部和欧洲联盟联合资助的一家企业的技术。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: AbuBakr Bahaj, in charge of the Southampton research, said: The prospects for energy from tidal currents are far better than from wind because the flows of water are predictable and constant.
sentences.zh: 负责南安普敦研究的AbuBakr Bahaj说:潮汐流的能源前景远比风好,因为水流是可预测和恒定的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The technology for dealing with the hostile saline environment under the sea has been developed in the North Sea oil industry and much is already known about turbine blade design, because of wind power and ship propellers.
sentences.zh: 北海石油工业开发了处理海上敌对盐碱环境的技术,由于风力和轮船螺旋桨,在涡轮机叶片设计方面已经有许多人知道。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: There are a few technical difficulties, but I believe in the next five to ten years we will be installing commercial marine turbine farms.
sentences.zh: 有一些技术困难,但我相信在今后五至十年中,我们将安装商业海洋涡轮机农场。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: ’ Southampton has been awarded £215,000 over three years to develop the turbines and is working with Marine Current Turbines, a subsidiary of IT power, on the Lynmouth project.
sentences.zh: 南安普敦在三年内获得215 000英镑, 开发涡轮机, 并正与信息技术电力子公司Marine Rent Turbines合作,

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: EU research has now identified 106 potential sites for tidal power, 80% round the coasts of Britain.
sentences.zh: 欧盟的研究现已查明106个潜在的潮汐动力地点,80%环绕英国海岸。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The best sites are between islands or around heavily indented coasts where there are strong tidal currents.
sentences.zh: 最佳地点在岛屿之间或严重缩水的海岸附近,那里有强大的潮汐。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: D A marine turbine blade needs to be only one third of the size of a wind generator to produce three times as much power.
sentences.zh: D 海洋涡轮机刀片需要仅是风力发电机大小的三分之一,才能产生三倍的电力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The blades will be about 20 metres in diameter, so around 30 metres of water is required.
sentences.zh: 刀片直径约为20米,因此需要约30米的水。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Unlike wind power, there are unlikely to be environmental objections.
sentences.zh: 与风力不同,不可能出现环境反对。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Fish and other creatures are thought unlikely to be at risk from the relatively slow-turning blades.
sentences.zh: 鱼类和其他生物被认为不大可能受到相对缓慢的转弯刀片的危险。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Each turbine will be mounted on a tower which will connect to the national power supply grid via underwater cables.
sentences.zh: 每个涡轮机将安装在塔上,通过水下电缆连接到国家电力供应网。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The towers will stick out of the water and be lit, to warn shipping, and also be designed to be lifted out of the water for maintenance and to clean seaweed from the blades.
sentences.zh: 塔台将从水中伸出来,点亮灯光,警告航运,并设计成从水中取出,用于维修,从刀片上净出海草。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E Dr Bahaj has done most work on the Alderney site, where there are powerful currents.
sentences.zh: 巴哈杰博士在奥尔德尼遗址做了大部分工作,那里有强大的水流。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The single undersea turbine farm would produce far more power than needed for the Channel Islands and most would be fed into the French Grid and be re-imported into Britain via the cable under the Channel.
sentences.zh: 单一海底涡轮机场的发电量远远超过海峡群岛所需的电力,大部分将输入法国网格,通过海峡下的电缆再进口到英国。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: F One technical difficulty is cavitation, where low pressure behind a turning blade causes air bubbles.
sentences.zh: F 技术困难之一是蒸发,在蒸发后,转动刀片背后的低压力造成气泡。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: These can cause vibration and damage the blades of the turbines.
sentences.zh: 这些可引起振动,破坏涡轮机的刀片。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Dr Bahaj said: ‘We have to test a number of blade types to avoid this happening or at least make sure it does not damage the turbines or reduce performance.
sentences.zh: 巴哈博士说:`我们必须测试一些刀片类型以避免这种情况发生,或至少确保它不会损坏涡轮机或降低性能。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Another slight concern is submerged debris floating into the blades.
sentences.zh: 另一个轻微的关切是漂浮在刀片中的沉积碎片。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: So far we do not know how much of a problem it might be.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止,我们不知道它可能是一个多大的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: We will have to make the turbines robust because the sea is a hostile environment, but all the signs that we can do it are good.
sentences.zh: 我们必须使涡轮机坚固,因为海洋是一个敌对的环境,但所有迹象表明,我们能够做到这一点,都是好的。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
